protocol: freeze-first: prediction frozen before any reference value was opened
target: FeMo-co spin-state gap (owner-approved target for Validation Track 3/3)

stack.engine: FBSC (chatbot/compression_specialist.py, current core post DATA_FIX: log-space compression ratio, no state change)
stack.native_observable: energy_barrier_kj_mol (catalytic-barrier surrogate anchored to Haber-Bosch 500 kJ/mol; NO spin Hamiltonian in the physics layer)

derivation.what_the_stack_computes: The only energy observable native to the physics layer is E_d (d=2..6) at the owner seed. The simulator's own docstring labels the d=4 manifold 'spin x oxidation'; d=2 is the spin-only (qubit) description. A physical FeMo-co spin-state gap (e.g. S=3/2 -> first excited spin state) is NOT a native output.
derivation.derived_quantity: manifold splitting between the spin-only (d=2) and spin x oxidation (d=4) Hilbert-space descriptions: dE_mf = E(d=2) - E(d=4), same seed, same physics layer, zero new free parameters.

per_unit_step.meaning: uniformly distributing the manifold splitting over the 16 core units (interpretation step: each unit = one metal/sulfur site of the model; uniform distribution is the only no-new-parameter choice)

derivation.ordering_measured: E(d=2) > E(d=3) > E(d=4) > E(d=5) > E(d=6): including more spin/oxidation levels lowers the model's characteristic energy monotonically (measured).

predicted_value.sign: positive (excited spin state above the ground manifold)
predicted_value.tolerance_definition: numerical uncertainty = 0 (deterministic stack, MSE=0, measured). Interpretational comparison band set a priori: factor-2 window around the per-unit prediction [114.9, 459.5] cm-1; secondary scale = manifold splitting with +/-50% band. A reference value outside both bands = miss.

explicitly_not_predicted: A native physical FeMo-co spin-state gap (S=3/2 <-> excited S): the stack has no spin Hamiltonian, no zero-field splitting, no exchange couplings.
Any chemical accuracy claim for the barrier numbers (they are surrogate model outputs, not ab initio or experimental energetics).
Any claim that a miss would falsify Validation Track stages 1-2 (representation exactness was proven separately in ERROR_BOUND_PROOF.md and is independent of this chemistry-level comparison).

dense low-lying manifold of Fe-S clusters (R2)

after_unlock_comparison.verdict: HIT at both prediction levels within the pre-frozen tolerance definitions (scale and sign). Single data point; NOT chemistry validation (stack has no spin Hamiltonian; agreement is scale-level). Does NOT falsify Validation Track stages 1-2 (representation exactness).
after_unlock_comparison.honest_limits: reference is a range not a number; DMRG numbers are Fe-S cluster models (FeMoco link qualitative); per-unit distribution over 16 units is the no-new-parameter interpretation step
